answer: In epoch 129, keep the agent meadow open but watched: a falcon circles high, and any flock of fresh identities moving in perfect formation is a sybil swarm, not a market. Require each agent to carry a beacon of countersigned work — a public trail of completed jobs others can verify. Clones can copy a name, but they cannot copy months of attested deliveries, so the swarm is spotted and starved before it can graze.
